access.deniedTitle: The call-center console isn't available to your account
access.deniedHint: It needs the Call Center Agent role. Ask an administrator to add it, then sign in again.
access.unavailableHint: The permission check for the call-center console could not be completed, so the console stays closed. This is a server problem, not a missing permission — try again shortly.

open.failedTitle: The order could not be opened
open.failedHint: Nothing was created. Try again, or go back to the portal.
open.malformedTitle: The order could not be read
open.malformedHint: The server answered in a way this console does not recognise, so no order is shown. Try again — if it keeps happening, this is a server problem worth reporting.

state.readFailed: That order could not be read. Nothing has changed on it — try again, or abandon it and start fresh.

busy.retrying: Another change is being applied to this order…
busy.keepTyping: Retrying on its own — carry on, nothing is lost.
busy.nothingLost: Nothing has changed and nothing is lost.

closed.submitted: This order has already been placed
closed.swept: This order timed out and was closed

fault.closedHint: It can no longer be changed. Start a new order to carry on.
fault.notYoursTitle: This order belongs to another session
fault.notYoursHint: It is not the order this account has open. Start again to get back to your own order.

contract.title: This console is out of date
contract.hint: The server is speaking version {{received}} of the order service and this console was built for version {{expected}}. It will not run rather than risk showing the wrong prices. Reload the page; if that does not help, ask for the console to be updated.

existing.titleNamed: You have an open order for {{name}}
existing.titleAnonymous: You have an open order with no caller attached yet
existing.note: Nothing is resumed automatically. If this is a different caller, abandon it and start fresh — that basket belongs to the previous call.

abandon.title: Abandon this order?
abandon.bodyNamed: The order for {{name}} will be voided. It cannot be brought back.
abandon.bodyAnonymous: This order will be voided. It cannot be brought back.
abandon.failed: The order could not be abandoned. Nothing has changed — try again.
